context: Hello I am here to help you look for a movie trailer.
Hi, I have some time at home because of the Corona outbreak. I'd really like something to take my mind off of it.
What type of movies do you like?
It depends. I like romance, sometimes SCI-Fi. But I don't think I want to watch anything scary. I'm looking for something that I can really escape into.
Have you watched Interstellar?
Oh, that's a good one. I keep meaning to rewatch it because I always feel like I'm missing a little something.
If you like that one Ad Astra is another good space movie.
Is that the one with Brad Pitt?
Yes it came out in 2019, its another interesting story.
I didn't catch that one. I'll totally watch that tonight.
Yes its a great one to watch!
I'll accept. Thanks for your help.
of course your welcome!
Hey, before you go. Did you see the movie?
Yed I watched the movie. Another movie like Interstellar where their mission to space threatens the universe.
I'm wondering if there's a movie that doesn't have people losing kids or parents.
Jumanji 2 was a great movie and funny
I didn't see that in the theater either. I kind of don't like Kevin Hart though.
Yeah he can be too much thats forsure, its a great movie though without anyone losing their lives.
That's really helpful right now. I'll watch that one.
